evidence.proved: quoted forum comment: 'check out the DediRock Promo VPS Saver NY BF31 deal. It gives you 2 GB RAM, 1x vCore CPU, 30 GB SSD, 2 TB Bandwidth, a 1 Gbps Network Port, and 1 dedicated IPv4 for just $8.88 USD annually (under $0.75/month)'

quoted sibling plan on the vendor's own page, which is the Los Angeles rung and not this one: 'Promo VPS Saver LA BF $9.88 /year - 1 GB RAM, 1x vCore CPU, 10 GB SSD, 1 TB Bandwith, 1 Gbp/s connection, 1 IPv4, Virtualizor panel'

the billing panel returned a Cloudflare challenge to the text extractor ('just a moment / enable javascript and cookies to continue', upstream 403) and stayed on 'Just a moment...' in the headless browser, so no first-party price, stock or payment field could be read

a Florida entity-name search for DEDIROCK returns no row for 'Dedi Rock LLC'; the nearest entries are D & E DISPATCH SERVICES, LLC and DEDIS PROPERTIES LLC, all INACT, so the vendor's named Florida LLC was not found in the state register

notes: The row that would win's own ranking if it could be verified, and it could not. A dedicated IPv4 with 2 GB and 30 GB for USD 0.74 a month beats every NAT row on the second and fourth criteria at once, and because there is no forwarding layer there is no port budget and no UDP question. Three things stop it being the pick. The figures are a forum comment, not a vendor page: the billing panel answered a Cloudflare challenge to the text extractor and stayed on 'Just a moment...' in a headless browser, and the vendor's own Black Friday page lists only the Los Angeles siblings at USD 9.88 a year for 1 GB. The entity does not check out: the vendor names Dedi Rock LLC of Clearwater, Florida, and a Florida entity-name search returns no such company. And the SKU is annual-only, so the cost of finding out whether the seller is real is a year up front.

extras.price_arithmetic: USD 8.88 a year / 12 = USD 0.74 a month, paid in one go, from the forum figure. A VPS bills whether it runs or not, so the 24/7 and 10 h/day figures are the same.
